title: manettia
intro: Manettia, commonly known as Jamaica dogwood or pride of India, is a flowering plant native to tropical America. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antispasmodic properties. The therapeutic actions of Manettia include treating fever, diarrhea, and gastrointestinal issues, as well as being used as a sedative and anxiolytic agent. The bioactive constituents of Manettia include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
